import os,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()

def f(inp):
    H,W=len(inp),len(inp[0])
    fc=inp[0][0]
    # frame separators: rows fully frame-color inside potential frame; find frame boundary per row and take union
    bounds=[]
    for r in range(H):
        nz=[j for j in range(W) if inp[r][j]!=0 and inp[r][j]!=fc]
        bounds.append(nz)
    # frame width: for each row, rightmost frame-colored cell
    fw=max(j for j in range(W) for r in range(H) if inp[r][j]==fc)
    seps=[r for r in range(H) if all(inp[r][j]==fc for j in range(fw))]
    def bands_from_seps(seps,H):
        bs=[];prev=-1
        for s in seps+[H]:
            if s>prev+1: bs.append((prev+1,s-1))
            prev=s
        return bs
    bands=bands_from_seps(seps,H)
    # collect shapes
    shapes=[]
    for v in {inp[i][j] for i in range(H) for j in range(fw+1,W) if inp[i][j]!=0}:
        cs=[(i,j-fw-1) for i in range(H) for j in range(fw+1,W) if inp[i][j]==v]
        rs=[p[0] for p in cs]
        r0=min(rs); h=max(rs)-r0+1
        shapes.append({'v':v,'cells':[(r-r0,c) for r,c in cs],'h':h})
    shapes.sort(key=lambda s:(-sum(1 for c in s['cells'] for _ in [c]), s['v']))
    res=[[inp[r][c] for c in range(fw)] for r in range(H)]
    for bi,(rt,rb) in enumerate(bands):
        if bi>=len(shapes): continue
        s=shapes[bi]
        for dr,dc in s['cells']:
            res[rt+dr][dc]=s['v']
    return res

for k in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2']:
    got=f(G[k+' input']); exp=G[k+' output']
    print(k, got==exp)
print(json.dumps(f(G['Test input'])))

import os,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()

def f(inp):
    H,W=len(inp),len(inp[0])
    fc=inp[0][0]
    fw=max(k for k in range(1,W) if all(all(x==fc or x==0 for x in inp[r][:k]) for r in range(H)))
    shapes=[]
    for v in sorted({inp[i][j] for i in range(H) for j in range(fw,W) if inp[i][j]!=0}):
        cs=[(i,j-fw) for i in range(H) for j in range(fw,W) if inp[i][j]==v]
        rs=sorted(set(p[0] for p in cs))
        cnt=len(cs)
        shapes.append({'v':v,'count':cnt,'top':rs[0],'h':rs[-1]-rs[0]+1,'cells':cs})
    shapes.sort(key=lambda s:(-s['count'],s['v']))  # desc count, asc color tiebreak
    out=[[inp[r][c] for c in range(fw)] for r in range(H)]
    cur=1
    for s in shapes:
        r0o=cur
        for dr,c in [(r-s['top'],c) for r,c in s['cells']]:
            rr=r0o+dr
            if 0<=rr<H and 0<=c<fw: out[rr][c]=s['v']
        cur+=s['h']+1
    return out

for k in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2']:
    got=f(G[k+' input']); exp=G[k+' output']
    print(k, got==exp)
print(json.dumps(f(G['Test input'])))

import os,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()

def f(inp):
    H,W=len(inp),len(inp[0])
    fc=inp[0][0]
    fw=max(k for k in range(1,W) if all(all(inp[r][j]==fc or inp[r][j]==0 for j in range(k)) for r in range(H)))
    # separator rows: all cells in frame part are frame color
    seps=[r for r in range(H) if all(inp[r][j]==fc for j in range(fw))]
    bands=[];prev=-1
    for s in seps+[H]:
        if s>prev+1: bands.append((prev+1,s-1))
        prev=s
    shapes=[]
    for v in sorted({inp[i][j] for i in range(H) for j in range(fw,W) if inp[i][j]!=0}):
        cs=[(i,j-fw) for i in range(H) for j in range(fw,W) if inp[i][j]==v]
        rs=[p[0] for p in cs]; cls=[p[1] for p in cs]
        r0=min(rs); c0=min(cls)
        shapes.append({'v':v,'top':r0,'left':c0,'h':max(rs)-r0+1,'cells':cs})
    shapes.sort(key=lambda s:(s['left'],s['v']))   # leftmost column, tie: color asc
    out=[[inp[r][c] for c in range(fw)] for r in range(H)]
    idx=0
    for (rt,rb) in bands:
        s=shapes[idx]; ht=s['h']
        # place shape top-aligned within band
        for r,c in [(rr-(s['top']),c) for rr,c in s['cells']]:
            out[rt+r][c]=s['v']
        idx+=1
    return out

for k in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2']:
    got=f(G[k+' input']); exp=G[k+' output']
    print(k, got==exp)
print(json.dumps(f(G['Test input'])))

def f(inp):
    H,W=len(inp),len(inp[0]); fc=inp[0][0]
    # shape cells: nonzero, non-frame color; bw = max col index such that no shape cell is left of it
    hasshape=lambda r,c: inp[r][c] not in (0,fc)
    bwr=min(c for c in range(W) if any(hasshape(r,c) for r in range(H)))
    res=[row[:] for row in [inp[c] for c in range(0,bw)] ]   # frame columns kept
    scells=[(r,c,v) for r in range(H) for c in range(bwr,W) if hasshape(r,c) and v:=inp[r][c]]
    rs=[p[0] for p in scells]; axis=sum(rs)/len(rs)
    return None
# simpler cleaner impl: keep everything as-is, mirror only vertical, shift horizontally left by bwr? 
# but out keeps width == input width? outputs are 12 wide with trailing zeros. So width preserved, zero region kept.
def f(inp):
    H,W=len(inp),len(inp[0]); fc=inp[0][0]
    bwr=min(c for c in range(W) if any(inp[r][c] not in (0,fc) for r in range(H)))
    res=[row[:] for row in inp]
    shapes={}
    for r in range(H):
        for c in range(bwr,W):
            v=inp[r][c]
            if v!=0 and v!=fc: shapes.setdefault(v,[]).append((r,c))
    allrs=[r for ps in shapes.values() for p in ps for r in [p[0]]]
    axis=(min(allrs)+max(allrs))/2
    for v,ps in shapes.items():
        for r,c in ps:
            rr=int(round(2*axis-r)); cc=c-bwr
            res[rr][cc]=v
            res[r][c]=0
    return res

from collections import Counter
import json
# Rule from the last analysis:
# - Frame color = most common. Shapes = non-frame nonzero comps.
# - In each demo, output order by min row (top): colors 3,6,2 in demo1; 1,2,3 in demo2.
#   Demo1 input band-top order (sorted by top): [3(at1),6(at4),2(at7)]? Actually tops: shape at rows1-2(2), 4-5(3), 7-8(6). Output order top->bottom: 3,6,2 => REVERSED band order.
#   Demo2 input tops: 3@1-3, 2@5-7, 1@9-11 -> reversed: 1,2,3 => matches output order! Yes.
# So: sort shapes by min row ascending (input order), then reverse list for stacking top to bottom in output frame.
# Left: shift so leftmost cell of each shape lands at column 1 (margin of frame).
# Also output has same height as input with only frame color where shapes aren't.
def f(I):
    H,W=len(I),len(I[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for row in I for x in row); fc=max(cnt,key=cnt.get)
    seen=[[False]*W for _ in range(H)]; comps=[]
    for r in range(H):
        for c in range(W):
            if I[r][c]!=fc and I[r][c]!=0 and not seen[r][c]:
                st=[(r,c)]; seen[r][c]=True; comp=[]; col=I[r][c]
                while st:
                    rr,cc=st.pop(); comp.append((rr,cc))
                    for dr in(-1,0,1):
                        for dc in(-1,0,1):
                            nr,nc=rr+dr,cc+dc
                            if 0<=nr<H and 0<=nc<W and not seen[nr][nc] and I[nr][nc]==col:
                                seen[nr][nc]=True; st.append((nr,nc))
                comps.append((col,comp))
    # sort by top, then reverse, starting placement at row 1 (first frame row below top border? frame starts at 0)
    out=[[fc]*W for _ in range(H)]
    items=sorted(comps,key=lambda t:min(p[0] for p in t[1]))[::-1]
    pos=1
    for col,comp in items:
        rs={p[0] for p in comp}; cs={p[1] for p in comp}
        tr=min(rs); tc=min(cs)
        hh=max(rs)-tr+1
        shift=1-tc
        for r,c in comp:
            out[r-(tr)+pos][c+shift]=col
        pos+=hh
    return out
